verdict.rationale: Antigravity documents its own MCP support for connecting the agent to external tools and remote APIs to fetch structured context, and plugins can bundle MCP servers. The changelog also shows Google Drive links surfacing as external documents. However, no first-party Jira or Slack connectors are documented, so connecting those relies on generic MCP configuration whose depth is unproven. Missing for 10: named Jira/Slack integrations, documentation of how Google Drive content is pulled into agent context, hands-on corroboration of workflow-tool connections.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context

citations.quote: MCP lets Antigravity fetch structured context directly or execute safe actions on your behalf when needed.
lets AI agents and editors securely connect to local developer tools, databases, file parsers, and external remote APIs
External files such as Google Drive links, PDFs, and Office documents now appear in their own Documents section in the sidebar above Artifacts.
Plugins are namespaced bundles that allow you to extend Antigravity’s capabilities by grouping skills, rules, MCP servers, and hooks into a single package.
